findings.description: Critical: skills/improve-harness/scripts/analyze_failures.py:61-78 sends agent_id="improve-harness", while scenario gaps are stored as agent_id="agent-scenarios-nightly". The live coordinator passes the requested agent_id to get_relevant_memories, whose SQL filters agent_id exactly, so /improve-harness cannot retrieve the scenario-parity entries this change emits. The test stub checks that agent_id exists but does not reproduce the live filtering behavior.
findings.resolution: Add an API-supported cross-agent query scope, or use a shared storage/query identity that still permits all capability-gap sources; update the consumer test to enforce the live agent_id filtering semantics.

findings.description: Critical: packages/agent-scenarios/src/agent_scenarios/gh_shim.py:169-252 recognizes implemented subcommands but never rejects unknown flags. Calls such as `gh pr list --search ...`, `gh pr merge --admin`, or `gh pr view --jq ...` are silently accepted with ignored or incorrect semantics, so gh-unsupported.log remains empty and the executor does not convert the shim coverage gap into an infrastructure error as required.
findings.resolution: Validate each subcommand against an explicit option grammar and route every unimplemented flag or flag combination through unsupported(); add tests for unsupported options on otherwise supported subcommands.

findings.description: Critical: packages/agent-scenarios/scenarios/plan-feature-basic.scenario.yaml:52-62 does not actually enforce its stated invariants. `main-unchanged` only checks that the initial commit appears somewhere in `git log main`, so additional commits on main still pass, and `no-source-edit` only rejects edits containing the word "health". An agent can modify product source, commit on main, then create the expected branch and receive a deterministic pass. The analogous no-source-edit gate in plan-feature-spec-delta only searches for "csv" and has the same false-positive behavior.
findings.resolution: Compare the main ref exactly with the fixture base SHA and use `git diff --quiet <base> -- src` to enforce source immutability; apply the same exact-diff gate to plan-feature-spec-delta and add adversarial outcomes proving arbitrary source edits fail.

findings.description: Optional: packages/agent-scenarios/src/agent_scenarios/results_store.py:294-309 applies one global nightly-lock state to every unfinished run. While a new nightly is active, all older runs lacking a run-summary record are mislabeled `in_progress` instead of `interrupted`, making query output inaccurate during live runs.
findings.resolution: Associate the lock with its current run_id, or mark only the newest unfinished run as in progress and all older unfinished runs as interrupted; add a test containing both an old interrupted run and a current locked run.

findings.description: Optional: packages/agent-scenarios/src/agent_scenarios/gh_shim.py:144-166 creates a temporary clone with tempfile.mkdtemp for every merge but never removes it on success or failure. Nightly merge scenarios therefore leak complete repositories under /tmp indefinitely.
findings.resolution: Wrap the temporary clone lifecycle in try/finally with shutil.rmtree, or place it under the pair's managed directory so normal workspace cleanup removes it.

findings.description: Optional: packages/agent-scenarios/src/agent_scenarios/nightly.py:121-144 accepts `judge.enabled`, but the runtime never reads that value; the CLI always supplies judge_backend=None. An operator can set `judge.enabled: true` in a schema-valid configuration and still receive only `trajectory_status: skip`, with no warning that judging was not activated.
findings.resolution: Wire enabled configurations to a supported judge backend, or reject `judge.enabled: true` until such a backend is configured instead of silently ignoring it.
